thread:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — Celestia Health asked for a compact enablement sprint next week. goal: onboard their infra team to Dedicated + run a quick cost/latency playbook. renewal convo scheduled for end of month so we want to de-risk now.

Akshay: Thanks — rough sizing? how many attendees and do they need sandbox access?

Maya (CS): ~8 engineers (mix infra + app), 3 product owners. They want hands-on, so sandbox + 1:1 office hours after training. Prefer APAC-friendly times (they're EMEA/APAC split).

Jamie PM: Can we do 3 sessions: 90m migration workshop (deep dive), 60m cost/ops review, 45m follow-up office hours? Proposed days Tue/Wed/Thu.

Tao (Enablement): I can facilitate the migration workshop. Will need 1-2 co-hosts for breakout benches. Volunteers? :raising_hand:

Luis: I can co-host Tue migration and run the cost review Wed. Will need the checklist and infra pre-reqs from Maya to circulate.

Maya (CS): Agenda draft below — please comment. planning to attach to calendar invite and the customer pre-read.

Maya (CS): ```Agenda: 1) 15m intro + goals 2) 45m dedicated migration walkthrough (config, network, KMS) 3) 20m hands-on lab (sample deploy + perf test) 4) 10m next steps and office hours signups 
Follow-up session Wed: cost/perf tuning (60m) 
Office hours Thu: 45m open Q&A + 3x 15m 1:1 slots (optional)```

Akshay: Nice. For the hands-on lab we'll need a `celestia-staging` project with dedicated GPU quota. Maya can we confirm infra creds and whether they want private/private-public deployment?

Maya (CS): I pinged their infra lead in private, they want Dedicated in VPC + private control plane. I'll get creds by EOD today.

Enablement Bot: Reminder: create calendar invites with timezone conversion link and include pre-read doc template — https://redwood.company/templates/enablement-pre-read (auto-prompt)

Tao (Enablement): I'll prepare the lab workbook. Can someone reserve a host slot for a recorded run? We may need 8 concurrent KV cache tests, so plan GPU sizing accordingly.

Luis: I'll open a ticket with Eng-Infra for a temporary extra GPU node pool and link it here when approved.

Jamie PM: Logistics: proposed times (local to Celestia): Tue 09:30 IST / Wed 02:00 UTC / Thu 22:00 JST — these map to reasonable overlap windows. Can we land on exact times by EOD?

Maya (CS): I'll run a quick Doodle and shoot options — aiming for Tue 2024-06-11 09:30 IST as primary. Posting invite once infra OK.

Akshay: Quick ask: can we add a one-slide renewal risk summary to the Friday prep so account exec has talking points? I'll draft and share.

Maya (CS): Yes please. Include: usage gaps, blockers, timeline to production, and support SLOs.

Jamie PM: +1 to a short checklist for the customer pre-read: network ACLs, KMS policies, sample traffic profile, and expected seq length. I'll attach a checklist template.

Luis: Ticket created: ENGINFRA-9472 — temp GPU pool request. ETA 24h. :thumbsup:

Maya (CS): Perfect. Action items: Maya = Doodle + creds; Tao = lab workbook + recording slot; Luis = infra ticket update; Akshay = renewal slide; Jamie = checklist.

Akshay: I'll jump into the 1:1 slots on Thu if any sticky perf regressions show up.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — will post final invite and pre-read once I have the staging project. :rocket:
